query:
insert into RequirementParents (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        req_id,
                        parent_product_id,
                        parent_req_id,
                        optional,
                        aspect
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5,
                        false,
                        $6
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        req_id,
                        parent_product_id,
                        parent_req_id
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        optional = excluded.optional,
                        aspect = excluded.aspect
